stem:
What do you have to do to each number in Column A to get the number next to it in Column B?

| Column A | Column B |
| --- | --- |
| 10 | 2 |
| 15 | 3 |
| 25 | 5 |
| 50 | 10 |

options.label: A
options.text: Add 8 to the number in Column A.

options.label: B
options.text: Subtract 8 from the number in Column A.

options.label: C
options.text: Multiply the number in Column A by 5.

options.label: D
options.text: Divide the number in Column A by 5.
